Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the name parameter in getdata requests. The issue lies in the failure to properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process. Ecava has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
